cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start the apology again, please. You interrupted the chair when you spilled that tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That covers the cleaning. Now address the interruption of the chair. One complete sentence, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair. Please use the title; we've already dealt with my trousers.

reason: Make A conduct a precise oral correction instead of prefacing inherited dialogue with generic professionalism; retain the office-versus-person demand.
